api: Dockside Books, a small shop's order API

endpoints.name: find_orders
endpoints.description: List a customer's orders, newest first. Use it to answer where an order is, before you change one.

endpoints.name: get_order
endpoints.description: Read one order by its id, with its items and status. Use it after find_orders gives you the id.

params.name: orderId
params.about: The order id, for example ORD-1041

endpoints.name: add_gift_note
endpoints.description: Add a short gift note to an order that has not shipped. Use it only when the customer asks for a note.

params.name: orderId
params.about: The order id, for example ORD-1041

params.name: note
params.about: The note text, up to 200 characters

endpoints.name: cancel_order
endpoints.description: Cancel an order that has not shipped. This cannot be undone. Use it only after the customer says yes.

params.name: orderId
params.about: The order id, for example ORD-1041
